name: Restaurant Operations
description: Starter pack for restaurant and food-service operations: opening and closing checklists, food safety logs, inventory counts and license renewals.

definitions.title: Opening checklist
steps: Turn on equipment and check temperatures
Check dining room and restrooms are clean
Verify staff arrival and station assignment

definitions.title: Closing checklist
definitions.note: Complete after the last guests leave.
steps: Clean stations and store food properly
Count the till and lock the safe

definitions.title: Cooler and freezer temperature log
definitions.note: Record cooler, freezer and hot-hold temperatures twice a day.
steps: Note any unit outside the safe range

definitions.title: Weekly line check
definitions.note: Full food safety walkthrough: dates, labels, storage order, cleaning.

definitions.title: Weekly inventory count
definitions.note: Count stock and compare with usage; prepare the supplier order list.

definitions.title: Supplier order
definitions.note: Place the weekly order with suppliers before the cutoff time.

definitions.title: Grease trap service
definitions.note: Confirm the grease trap service report and file it.

definitions.title: Hood and exhaust cleaning
definitions.note: Verify the hood and exhaust cleaning certificate.

definitions.title: Monthly pest control
definitions.note: Pest control visit - file the service report.

definitions.title: Fire extinguisher check
definitions.note: Check gauges, seals and access on all extinguishers.

definitions.title: Quarterly health inspection prep
definitions.note: Self-inspection with the health checklist and fix findings before the inspector arrives.

definitions.title: Food handler certification renewal
definitions.note: Check staff certifications and book renewals before expiry.

definitions.title: Business and liquor license renewal
definitions.note: Renew business and liquor licenses before year end.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc equipment repair
definitions.note: One-off repair call - set the due date when creating it.
